title: 控制台：一次拒绝带多条原因时，提示框逐行列出全部原因（接 #36877）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-ruled, term (6) of the ruling on #36877 (comment 7178348458; Bill, decision card 2026-11-26T00:01Z, option verbatim 「A 一次抛多条原因逐行翻译」), filed by the owning zone under the parent. Source: maintainer.
Grading: area:ux · Feature · p2 (with the parent) · reach: every action or hook refusal that lists several reasons, once #36877 ships · evidence: ruling text; premise 4 of the analysis 7178064820.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：服务端（#36877）可以在一次拒绝里给出多条已翻译的原因，每条一行。控制台现在只显示第一句，其余藏在「更多」里；改成在同一个提示框里逐行列出。
- 谁受益：批量提交被整体拒绝的用户，一眼看到每一条为什么不行。
- 不做会怎样：服务端翻好的多条原因，用户只看到第一条。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

Ruling on #36877, term (6), verbatim: "Console: a ui follow-up card under this one renders a multi-line `userMessage` as a list in the alert box."
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/RefusalMessage.tsx` today shows a refusal's first sentence with the rest behind "More" (analysis premise 4). When a refusal carries several lines (`userMessage` joined by `\n`, and `details.refusals: [{ reason, message }]` from #36877), render each line as a list item in the same alert box; the entry's closing line stays last.

## Acceptance

- A refusal answer with several lines shows every line, in order, in one alert box, without a "More" toggle hiding them; a single-sentence refusal renders as today.
- A pin for both cases.

## Order

After the #36877 server PR merges (it defines the wire shape).

Blocked-by: #36877

Reader: zone o5-U (seat repo:objectstack#5).
Dedupe: open issues for "RefusalMessage" and "multi-line refusal" return none besides #36877.
